name: Phoenix Food LLC
old_description: Prepare quick and delicious meals and desserts that will impress your family and guests with Phoenix Food LLC’s dry mixes. As a leading dry mix manufacturing company, we deliver great-tasting, easy-to-make soups, dinners, desserts, side dishes, and dips to millions of individuals. For over 20 years, our brands have been helping customers create memorable culinary experiences, no matter how busy life gets.
about:
Phoenix Food LLC operates from Canton, Texas, where it has produced dry mixes for more than two decades. The company was founded over 20 years ago, though a precise founding year is not publicly disclosed, and ownership details have not been shared. It began as a manufacturer focused on bringing convenient, flavorful meal solutions to home cooks.

The company specializes in dry mix manufacturing, producing a wide range of products including soups, entrees, biscuits, breads, baking essentials, desserts, no‑bake cheesecakes, and dip mixes. It operates under two consumer brands, Homemade Gourmet and Just In Time Gourmet, and also runs an extensive private‑label program for retail partners. The catalog comprises hundreds of existing formulations, all manufactured in‑house.

Phoenix Food serves the consumer packaged‑goods sector, supplying both its own branded lines and private‑label products to retailers across the United States. Its customer base includes millions of individual households as well as commercial partners seeking custom mix formulations. The company emphasizes its ability to meet diverse taste preferences and occasion‑driven demand.

According to the company, its differentiators lie in the use of premium ingredients, versatile product applications, and time‑saving preparation. It also cites a commitment to stringent quality controls and industry‑leading delivery and turnaround performance as reasons clients choose its manufacturing services.
